_purpose: Pair-to-strategy registry for the PAPER executors. Maps every monitored pair to its assigned strategy family, executor, timeframe, version, tradeable state, and bounded risk profile. Consumed by app/user_data/strategies/PaperAutonomous.py (daily), FamilyDispatcher/MomentumAlt (fast 5m), FamilyDispatcher/SwingAlt (swing 1h), app/indicators/families.py (the per-family signal math routed by strategy_family), app/scripts/preflight.py, and app/scripts/crypto_status_monitor.py. BTC's baseline math is NOT defined here — it lives in BtcZScore and is preserved by subclassing.
revised: 2026-10-22 rev4 (MULTI-ASSET / MULTI-STRATEGY expansion, owner-approved plan): added SOL/UNI to the fast executor (LIVE-STRICT, pass the cost/liquidity gate); LINK reassigned to its improved link_trend family; added a THIRD disjoint 1h 'swing' executor carrying the PAPER-RELAXED wide-spread names LTC/AVAX/DOGE on cost-aware rsi_divergence/bb_squeeze families. Best-by-expectancy family per pair is finalized by the Phase C backtest pass.
authorization: Autonomous PAPER BUY/SELL/HOLD/EXIT for eligible non-BTC crypto under app/configs/paper_risk_policy.json (owner directives 2026-10-21 / 2026-10-22). Alts trade intraday (5m) on the fast executor and hourly (1h swing) on the swing executor, each a SEPARATE, DISJOINT process from the BTC daily baseline. PAPER ONLY — not live.

risk.note: Baseline preserved exactly (EMA65/STD65/Z/transitions/daily TF/version). Stake 15 = Alpaca's ~$15 BTC/USD minimum order notional (a $10 stake is silently un-fillable); do not set BTC stake below that floor.

FVG/OB (research).reason_not_traded: Executed on 1H/5M; the single authoritative executor runs a 1D strategy (BTC baseline preserved). Wiring 5M/1H entries into the same bot would change BTC's execution model, so per owner brief §5 we document the limitation rather than fake an integration. The relaxed (require_overlap=False) variant showed a negative expectancy after fees and stays DISABLED. Strict-sequence forward data collection continues in the read-only layer.
